CollectionView.purpose: Browse a list/grid of entities with optional create CTA, empty state, and custom row/tile content.
howTo: Wait until runtime.loading is false before acting on items or empty state.
Create: click primary CTA (primaryHref/primaryLabel) or empty-state action when list is empty.
Open an item: use product.actions edit hrefTemplate with the item id, or ContextMenu on the row/tile.
Delete: usually via ContextMenu → ConfirmDialog (product.actions delete.confirm).
Toggle tiles/list when viewMode is both.

loading.desc: Show spinner; empty state must not show while true

defaultLayout.desc: Initial layout when viewMode is both

emptyTitle.desc: Empty-state heading when items is empty and not loading

emptyActionHref.desc: CTA href when empty (falls back to primaryHref)

columns.desc: Table/tile column keys, labels, cell types (identity|pill|text)

row.desc: Custom table row cells; receives item

header_actions.desc: Extra header controls next to view toggle / primary CTA

item_href_template.desc: When set (e.g. /items/{id}), tile and row click navigates; skips interactive controls

layout_storage_key.desc: localStorage key for tiles|list preference (survives navigation when viewMode is both)

CreateFormShell.purpose: CRUD form page shell for create or edit: sticky chrome, progress submit, body/footer slots.
howTo: Fill FormField controls inside children until requiredValues are non-empty.
Submit via FormProgress primary button when complete (when show_submit).
Back navigates to backHref (list or detail).
mode=edit sets role edit-form; use footer for delete / danger actions.
loading shows spinner instead of children.

title.desc: Form title (e.g. Add Wear Test / Edit Wear Test)

backHref.desc: Back navigation target (fallback when history unavailable)

requiredValues.desc: Values that must be non-empty for submit readiness

onSubmit.desc: Called when user submits a complete form

header_actions.desc: Extra header CTAs left of submit

footer.desc: Below body — danger zone, secondary actions

agent.desc: Product intent (create-X / update-X), entity, fields, api

DetailShell.purpose: CRUD read-only detail page shell: back + title + header actions; body slots for sections.
howTo: Wait until runtime.loading is false before reading fields.
Primary actions (Edit) live in header_actions.
Body children typically FormSection + DetailField (or custom).
Back uses backHref (usually collection list).

agent.desc: Product intent view-X, entity, fields, api

DetailField.purpose: Read-only labeled attribute for DetailShell body sections.
howTo: Prefer value/empty_label for text; pre for JSON; mono for ids.
Use children for custom value UI (StatusPill, links).

FormField.purpose: Labeled input with required indicator and incomplete/filled/error bar.
howTo: Set value on the control (text/date/select/textarea).
Required fields show amber bar when empty, green when filled.
Prefer product.fields metadata on the parent form for entity field meaning.

ContextMenu.purpose: Vertical-ellipsis (⋮) menu for row/tile actions (Edit, Delete, …).
howTo: Click the ⋮ trigger to open the menu.
Choose an item by label; href items navigate, onSelect items run handlers.
Destructive items use danger styling; may open ConfirmDialog.

agent.desc: Usually inherits entity from parent collection row

ConfirmDialog.purpose: Modal confirm/cancel — Svelte replacement for window.confirm.
howTo: Only act when runtime.open is true (or open the dialog via product flow first).
Confirm runs onConfirm then closes; Cancel/Escape/backdrop runs onCancel.
variant=danger styles confirm as destructive (delete).

busy.desc: Disable buttons while async work runs

AlertDialog.purpose: Modal OK notice — replacement for window.alert.
howTo: When open, read message and click OK (onOk).

PromptDialog.purpose: Modal text input — replacement for window.prompt.
howTo: When open, set the input value, then OK (onConfirm) or Cancel.

Modal.purpose: Base modal overlay used by dialogs.
howTo: Prefer ConfirmDialog/AlertDialog/PromptDialog for agent flows.

EmptyState.purpose: Centered empty placeholder with optional CTA.
howTo: If actionHref/actionLabel present, that is the create/add path when the collection is empty.

PageHeader.purpose: Title, description, and action slot for a page section.
howTo: Primary actions may live in the actions snippet (toggles, create buttons).

AgentSurface.purpose: Collects all data-veil-agent nodes into window.__veilAgentSurface for agents.
howTo: Mount once per app/layout.
Read window.__veilAgentSurface.surfaces or listen for veil:agent-surface.
